depth4_cp4im_anytime.description: Scaled gym target: average primal gap integral over deterministic restart/iteration effort, excess error, and optimality proof rate on three CP4IM datasets at max depth 4 with 16 selected features.
depth4_cp4im_anytime.notes: This experiment is not reported in the paper. It is the gym's scaled CPU benchmark using the paper's constrained decision-tree task. Values are stored here as validator anchors for the reusable benchmark; the paper-reported reference results are the depth-5, depth-6, and depth-7 entries above.

avg_primal_gap_integral.description: Lower anytime primal gap integral rewards maintaining a better incumbent relative to the proven optimum over a fixed deterministic restart/iteration effort window.

avg_excess_error_rate.description: Lower final excess training-error rate rewards ending the scoring window closer to the optimal constrained tree.

optimality_proved_rate.description: Higher proof rate rewards methods that certify optimality rather than only returning heuristic incumbents.
